description: Climatiq sells a cloud API that calculates greenhouse gas emissions of freight shipments for logistics software, supply chain planning, enterprise resource planning and transport management systems. Contents and functions: it applies the GLEC Framework version 3 and picks emission factors automatically, with options for region, fuel type including electric, cargo weight, refrigeration and load type; it gives full life cycle results split into well-to-tank and tank-to-wheel emissions; smart routing computes routes with up to five legs in one call, including intermodal chains, adds pre- and post-legs to the nearest ports, terminals and airports, and includes logistics hub emissions. Climatiq says it is accredited by the Smart Freight Centre for GLEC compliance and has no stake in carbon offsets. Coverage: road, air, sea and rail across many regions. Format and access: a REST API with documentation and a demo. Licence and cost: commercial, with published pricing plans (not read). Caveats: factor tables sit behind the service, so results are only as open as the licence allows. It supplies per-shipment emission estimates for optimisation and network flow models that weigh freight routes by carbon. It relates to the HBEFA road transport emission factors in the catalogue.
